title: Wren and the Hymn
author: Felix Dunmore
blurb: Rafael Blackwood, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
